product.name: Managed Security
product.description: A fully managed detection and response service securing network infrastructure against cyber threats.

product.name: VARA Compliance Solutions
product.description: Cybersecurity solutions tailored to meet Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA) compliance requirements for crypto platforms.

product.name: Exchange Security
product.description: Security services focused on protecting cryptocurrency exchanges and trading platforms from breaches and hacks.

product.name: High Net Worth Individual Cybersecurity (Sentinel)
product.description: Tailored cybersecurity services providing discreet, intelligence-driven protection for ultra-high-net-worth individuals and their digital assets.

product.name: AML/KYC Compliance Solutions
product.description: Secure and cost-effective cybersecurity solutions to support Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) regulatory compliance.

product.description: Cybersecurity services tailored to meet the regulatory standards of the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA).
